Remove any free-form narrative guidance from documented orchestrator patterns.

- plugins/dso/docs/ or relevant arch doc: add section documenting the closure handoff protocol: verifier emits P1, check-verifier-verdict.sh reads it, check-manifest-completeness.sh validates audit trail

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -c 'P1' CLAUDE.md → ≥1 (typed-enum field documented)
- grep -c 'render-closure-narrative\|check-verifier-verdict' CLAUDE.md → ≥1 (renderer + gate referenced)
- grep -rn 'write a narrative\|LLM summary\|free-form.*verdict' CLAUDE.md → 0 results (no prohibited patterns)
- bash validate.sh --ci or equivalent passes (no lint regressions)
